## Diamond Spider (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
 N Medium vermin  
 **Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +4  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 15, touch 13, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +2 natural)  
 **hp** 27 (3d8+3) plus 30 temporary hp  
 **Fort** +4, **Ref** +4, **Will** +1  
 **Immune** mind-affecting effects  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 30 ft., climb 30 ft.  
 **Melee** diamond blade +5/+5 (1d8, 15–20) or bite +2 (1d6 plus poison)  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 11, **Dex** 17, **Con** 12, Int—, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 2  
 **Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +2; **CMD** 15 (27 vs. trip)  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +11, Climb +16, Perception +4 (+8 in webs), Stealth +7 (+11 in webs); **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception, +4 Stealth (+8 in webs), +16 Climb  
 

**Special Abilities**

 
 **Poison (Ex)** Bite—injury; saving throw Fort DC 14; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1d2 Strength damage; cure 1 saving throw.  


 

**Ecology**

 
**Environment** any  
 **Organization** solitary, pair, or colony (3–8)  
 **Treasure** incidental
